root_cause: The promotion deploy changed the customer quote to free shipping while authorization continued to add flat shipping, so qualifying carts differed by 999 cents.
failure_discriminator: Carts at or above the free-shipping threshold declined; smaller carts continued to succeed.

evidence.excerpt: Enable free shipping for orders over $100
evidence.why: The deploy evidence shows the free-shipping change.
The quote path applies free shipping when the promotion qualifies.

falsification_attempted: A deploy-independent failure would not align with the config boundary and exact payment difference; the evidence did not show that alternative.
recommended_action: Make authorization reconcile against the same quoted total.
